# testing_discriminated_union (Resource)

DiscriminatedUnion Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_discriminated_union" "my_discriminatedunion" {
  item = {
    item_a = {
      type_varying_field = {
        key = jsonencode("value")
      }
      value_a = "...my_value_a..."
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item` (Attributes) Discriminated union for 'create' operations (non-array) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--item))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--item"></a>
### Nested Schema for `item`

Optional:

- `item_a` (Attributes) Test case - discriminator key 'item_a' matches ItemA, but different model name (tests the bug fix). Has 'type_varying_field' as map type matching ItemA. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--item--item_a))
- `item_b` (Attributes) Test case - exact match (both discriminator key and model name match). Has 'type_varying_field' as class type (defined properties) to test shared field names with different types across variants. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--item--item_b))
- `item_c` (Attributes) Test case - missing in 'update' union (only in 'create'). Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--item--item_c))
- `item_d` (Attributes) Test case - discriminator key differs in 'update' (item_d vs item_d_alt). Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--item--item_d))

<a id="nestedatt--item--item_a"></a>
### Nested Schema for `item.item_a`

Optional:

- `type_varying_field` (Map of String) Schema using additionalProperties (becomes map type). Used to test shared field names with structurally different types across discriminated union variants.
- `value_a` (String) Not Null; Requires replacement if changed.

Read-Only:

- `value_a_sensitive` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--item--item_b"></a>
### Nested Schema for `item.item_b`

Optional:

- `type_varying_field` (Attributes) Schema with defined properties (becomes class type). Used to test shared field names with structurally different types across discriminated union variants. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--item--item_b--type_varying_field))
- `value_b` (String) Not Null

<a id="nestedatt--item--item_b--type_varying_field"></a>
### Nested Schema for `item.item_b.type_varying_field`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `setting` (String) Not Null



<a id="nestedatt--item--item_c"></a>
### Nested Schema for `item.item_c`

Required:

- `value_c` (String) Requires replacement if changed.


<a id="nestedatt--item--item_d"></a>
### Nested Schema for `item.item_d`

Required:

- `value_d` (String) Requires replacement if changed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_discriminated_union.my_testing_discriminated_union
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_discriminated_union.my_testing_discriminated_union "..."
```
